## Story
As a <role>, I want <goal>, so that <benefit>.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Given ... when ... then ...

## Definition of Done
- [ ] All acceptance criteria met
- [ ] Merged to main through a pull request
- [ ] CI build is green
- [ ] Automated tests written and passing
- [ ] Every "No" in the RBAC matrix that this story touches is covered by a test
- [ ] Manual test case executed and documented
- [ ] README updated where relevant

## Testing sub-issues
- T-XX.X [TEST][auto] ...
- T-XX.X [TEST][manual] ...

Blocked by: #<issue>

<1, 2, 3, 5, 8 or 13>
